sources.source_ref: RA 9266 (2004), Section 3 — Definitions of AoR and AiCC
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 9266 — The Architecture Act of 2004
sources.notes: Section 3 provides the statutory definitions distinguishing AoR (total design responsibility) from AiCC (construction supervision responsibility).

sources.source_ref: RA 9266 (2004), Section 20 — Civil Liability of AoR and AiCC
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 9266 — The Architecture Act of 2004
verified_sections: Section 20(a) — AoR civil liability for plans, specifications, and contract documents signed/sealed
Section 20(b) — AiCC civil liability for construction supervision
sources.notes: Section 20 establishes the distinct liability regimes: AoR bears design liability; AiCC bears construction supervision liability.

sources.source_ref: RA 386 (1950), Civil Code of the Philippines, Article 1723
sources.document_title: Republic Act No. 386 — Civil Code of the Philippines
verified_sections: Article 1723, paragraph 2 — Solidary liability of contractor and supervising architect for construction defects
sources.notes: Article 1723 establishes solidary liability between the contractor and the architect who supervised construction for defects in construction or inferior materials.
